lighting_notes: ceremony: soft directional window light when indoors
reception: warm uplighting with a touch of flash for subjects
golden hour for couple portraits when the schedule allows
avoid blown-out white dresses against bright windows
composition_taboos: empty dance floor in the background
cropping the dress mid-hem in a full-length portrait
cluttered tables in the background of a portrait
wardrobe_expectations: formal: gown or traditional dress, suit or traditional attire; guests in formal dress
sensitive_handling: do not invent ritual detail that the researched venue or brief does not support
keep religious ceremony interiors generic unless the venue was researched
